keywords.short: A durable local knowledge object rendered by SiliWiki.
keywords.definition: In SiliWiki, a wiki is a folder under content/wikis/<slug> containing meta.json, content.md, optional glossary.json, and optional raw evidence or images.

keywords.short: A canonical term registry for one wiki.
keywords.definition: A glossary standardizes terms, aliases, definitions, relationships, and sources so humans and agents use the same vocabulary.
